measurement_policy.fallback: record UTF-8 character counts and mark token values as estimates when provider usage is unavailable
measurement_policy.estimation_method: Chinese-heavy text: UTF-8/Unicode character counts are recorded; any token estimate is explicitly non-provider and approximate

notes: The interactive assistant runtime did not expose provider token counters for this production turn; exact token fields remain null rather than fabricating precision.
Remotion rendering, local validation, file reads/writes and Edge TTS are not counted as LLM tokens.
